fact: A World Bank aide-memoire on a February 2025 mission says the lack of PKI encryption and an under-capacity ABIS have weakened the national ID system's security, and recommends restoring PKI and maintaining the ABIS.
title: Digital Malawi Acceleration Project (DMAP, P505095): Aide-Mémoire, ID Technical Discussions Mission, February 10 to 19, 2025
